texts.preamble: Chhote Lal & Anr vs The State Of Bihar Through The Principal ... on 30 August, 2017 Author: Birendra Kumar Bench: Birendra Kumar In The High Court Of Judicature At Patna Criminal Writ Jurisdiction Case No.1067 of 2017 ====================================================== 1. Chhote Lal, Son of Late Kalyan Singh, Resident of Village- Maheshpur Bilram, P.S. Dholna, District- Kashganj, Uttar Pradesh 2. Awadh Kihsore Jaiswal, Son of Sri Chubey Prasad Jaiswal, Resident of Village Bhairoganj, P.S.- Bhairoganj, District- West Champaran, Bihar .... Petitioners Versus 1. The State of Bihar Through The Principal Secretary, Department of Home, Government of Bihar, Patna 2. The Director General of Police, Bihar Patna 3. The Deputy Inspector General of Police, West Champaran, at Bettiah, Bettiah, Bihar 4. The Superintendent of Police, District Bagaha, (West Champaran), Bih 5. The Officer in Charge-cum-Investigation Officer, Bagaha (Bhairoganj) P.S., District West Champaran, Bihar .... Respondents = = = = = = Appearance : For the Petitioners : Mr. Prabhat Ranjan, Adv. For the Respondents : Mr. Anil Kumar Sinha, GA I ====================================================== CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE BIRENDRA KUMAR ORAL ORDER 2 30-08-2017
texts.facts: The petitioners have invoked the writ jurisdiction of this Court for quashment of Bagha (Bhairoganj) P.S. Case No. 32 of 2017, registered under Sections 414, 272, 273 and 284 of the Indian Penal Code, 26(ii) read with Section 4(i) of the Food Protection Act and Clause 2.3.4 of the Food Safety and Standards (Prohibition and Restriction of Sales) Regulation, 2011. I.A. No. 1695 of 2017 This interlocutory application has been filed by the petitioner for provisional release of the seized Pan Masala on the ground that the petitioner is a registered dealer in the name and style as M/S Jai Mata Di Sales and the seized Pan Masala was brought from Uttar Pradesh, after payment of all the required taxes even to the State of Bihar and Pan Masala is a standard item of food as held by the Division Bench of this Court
